title: ResearchClaim v1
description: A domain-neutral claim with explicit type, scope, disposition, evidence maturity, supporting evidence references, limitations, and non-entailments. Disposition and evidence maturity are separate axes; any value beyond proposed/draft requires non-empty supporting evidence. A claim never upgrades itself; only referenced evidence and later review can support it.

scope.description: Human-readable boundary within which the claim is made.

disposition.description: Lifecycle disposition of this claim record. inconclusive is a legitimate terminal assessment and must never be forced into supported/refuted.

evidence_maturity.description: Position on the governance evidence ladder (see docs/governance/RESEARCH_CLAIM_GOVERNANCE.md). Which rungs are reachable for which claim_type is domain-adapter policy, not core policy.

sha256.description: Optional content hash pinning the exact evidence record version.

supporting_evidence.description: May be empty only while disposition is proposed/inconclusive and evidence_maturity is draft.

limitations.description: Known limitations. Required; write an explicit empty array only after consideration.

non_entailments.description: Statements this claim explicitly does not establish. Required for the same reason.

supersedes.description: Optional claim_id of the prior claim this one revises. Append-only; earlier claims are never edited in place.
